newsitem.title: USA: Methode Q4 may miss analyst expectations.
newsitem.headline: Methode Q4 may miss analyst expectations.

text.p: Methode Electronics Inc, reporting higher January 31 third quarter results, said it does not expect to meet analysts' expectations for earnings for the fourth quarter.

"As we look out at the fourth quarter, we do not believe Methode will meet analysts' expectations for earnings although we do believe we can approach last year's record fourth quarter results," said chairman William McGinley in a statement.
In the year-ago fourth quarter, the manufacturer of electronic components reported earnings of $10.5 million, or $0.30 per share, up from $8.3 million, or $0.24.
Methode officials were not immediately available to elaborate.
The company reported third-quarter earnings rose to $0.26 per share from $0.22 per share in the same period the previous year ago, in line with the First Call consensus estimate.
For full-year fiscal 1997, First Call's mean earnings estimate for Methode is $1.11 per share. Methode recorded fiscal 1996 earnings of $0.93 per share.
